name: Mama Oldani’s Pasta
subtitle: Usually for Dutch oven
equipment: Dutch oven, or a stovetop pan
notes: A staple on Houghton camping trips. Serves 4–6 hungry eaters.

items: 1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped spinach, thawed
26 ounces Ragu Chunky Garden spaghetti sauce
Other vegetables such as onion and pepper, diced, optional

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Brown **1 pound ground beef** in Dutch oven (with 25 coals underneath), or in a pan on the stovetop.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Drain ground beef and add: **1 pound cooked pasta**, **1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped spinach, thawed**, **2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese**, **2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese**, **26 ounces Ragu Chunky Garden spaghetti sauce**, other vegetables such as onion and pepper, diced (optional), and salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Stir together gently. Return oven to coals, and bake for about 30 minutes (using 9 briquettes under the oven and 16 on top) until heated through. (Or in a 350°F oven.)
